done_when: forge upgrade treats an earlier upgrade fix whose pull request has merged as finished: it removes that fix's leftover worktree and local branch (only when they hold nothing unpushed) and carries on; an earlier upgrade fix that is still open, or has unpushed work, still refuses as today; a command test covers a repo adopted on an earlier release upgrading twice with the first fix's worktree left behind, plus the unpushed-work refusal
why: forge upgrade refuses with 'The upgrade to vX is still open in fix upgrade-forge-to-vX' when that earlier upgrade fix's pull request has merged and only its worktree was left behind (reported by a client session upgrading to v1.2.8)
